# `delivery_methods` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/delivery_methods.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Module id | `delivery_methods` |
| Name | Delivery Methods |
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Ships from | `@endora-commerce/mod-delivery-methods` |
| Licence | `MIT` |

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `delivery_methods.enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
| `organizations` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
| `shipments` | no | degrades-without `shipmentUsagePort` — Deleting a delivery method is refused, naming the shipments module. Every other surface — the catalog, the channel bindings, the storefront list, the writes — is unaffected. |
